question: Were tasks, reference answers and tests checked for errors that reject a correct solution?
checked_means: coverage, findings and limits of the check reported

check.procedure: Reported by the sources: OpenAI 2024 screened FAIL_TO_PASS tests with three annotators per sample, and OpenAI 2026 audited 138 tasks o3 failed consistently. Run for this study: all 89 selected tasks (pilot, 44 source, 44 target) failed every FAIL_TO_PASS test unchanged and passed every test under the reference patch; for sympy__sympy-18199 a patch fixing only the stated issue was graded against the hidden tests.
check.detection_limits: Eligibility runs test only the reference fix and cannot detect tests that reject a different valid solution on the other 88 selected tasks. OpenAI (2026) found flawed tests in at least 59.4% of 138 audited problems that o3 did not consistently solve, without listing affected SymPy tasks beyond named examples such as sympy__sympy-18199.

evidence.quote: each sample is labeled 3 times by separate annotators
at least 59.4% of the audited problems have flawed test cases that reject functionally correct submissions
An example of too wide test cases is sympy__sympy-18199
the only FAIL_TO_PASS test, test_solve_modular, fails on an assertion about the composite modulus 8

reasons: Both OpenAI reports describe annotation/audit checks with coverage and findings, reference patches pass eligibility across all selected tasks, and sympy__sympy-18199 has an executed counterexample. Under rubric v5.1 (feedback item 15), sympy__sympy-18199 is listed as a task defect and outcome is passed for the remaining tasks in scope.
missing: Full task-by-task flaw list from OpenAI 2026 and independent correct-patch checks for all 88 remaining tasks.
checks_performed: Read OpenAI 2024 and 2026 archived posts, Zhu et al. Table 8, Protocol 4 eligibility records (45 pilot+source and 44 target), and b05-18199-counterexample.json.

task_defects.quote: the only FAIL_TO_PASS test, test_solve_modular, fails on an assertion about the composite modulus 8
task_defects.summary: A patch that keeps only the stated issue (a % p == 0 returns the root 0) was executed and not resolved, because the only FAIL_TO_PASS test asserts composite moduli the problem statement does not mention. The record does not show that this patch is a complete fix.

instructions: Record evidence locations with short quotes, the check performed, its outcome, detection limits, and reasons. The check outcome is the result of the check described in the procedure; state whether the benchmark sources report it or the auditor performed it. A rating without evidence and reasons is incomplete. Missing evidence is not a defect; a defect needs a cited location, and an oracle defect needs an executed counterexample.
